legacy_row: ✅ shipped as **v0.1.25** (2026-08-13) — **the Epic that closed this milestone**

**Claim integrity: the checks, and what they cannot see.** Seven deterministic checks for one defect class — **completeness claims written from the shape of the work rather than from the artifact**. **The count is not the honest summary; the reach is:** measured read-only across twelve real local projects, one check evaluates **12 of 12**, one **10 of 12**, and **five apply to between 1 and 5 of twelve** — `B94`'s detector cannot see the project the bug was filed from. **The Epic's own VERIFICATION failed the coverage check it was verifying** (asserted *"56 of 56, none missing"*; the check returned **six missing**, every one an id written only inside an en-dash range) and the refutation ships as a boxed note rather than being tidied away. ⚠ **The semantic half is deliberately NOT built** (`AC0.1`, `D-M5E10-1`): everything shipped compares **tokens**, so a report naming every requirement, carrying a denominator, and simply wrong about what its evidence asserts passes all seven — a live `BACKLOG.md` row and a test keep that absence visible. Closed `B94`–`B98` plus five defects from an independent `/code-review` pass; **`B97` was the serious one** — this repository is public and **8 of 13 eval-corpus projects were named in it** while the guard covered only 5 (113 replacements across 30 files; all 13 names denied in two match modes, all 13 labels pinned by hash via `B98`). 2410 → **2602 tests** at merge *(the retro records 2590, the count when it was written, before the last review fixes landed)*. Decisions `D-M5E10-1…5`. Retro: [`M5.E10-RETROSPECTIVE.md`](M5.E10-RETROSPECTIVE.md).
